messages.author: Victor Nazarychev
messages.body:
Dear Amber's users,
Is it possible to parametrize boron nitride particles in the GAFF force
field?
If yes, how to add a new atom type for boron to the GAFF force field?
Best regards,
Victor

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Tue, Feb 01, 2022, Victor Nazarychev wrote:
>
>Is it possible to parametrize boron nitride particles in the GAFF force
>field?
Not at present. In preparation is an expansion of the elements covered by
GAFF, which will include boron. But that's not ready yet.
....dac

messages.author: Erdem Yeler
messages.body:
I used boron parameters from these articles results were very close to
experimentals (there is no B-N bond but it may help you):
https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0009261421003390
https://www.mdpi.com/1420-3049/25/9/2196
